senses.gloss: dominion, power, possession, esp. (sub. יום) a Roman festival commemorating the conquest of eastern countries.

senses.gloss: royal prohibition. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 104ᵇ sq. קבע ק׳ בני וכ׳ he issued a prohibition, that the Romans must not go down to Syria &c.; התיר ק׳ he cancelled the prohibition; Yalk. Ex. 273 (Ar. קבע קרטיסים בים, corr. acc.).
